title: Shinonome Ena — Gloomy Afternoon〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That cafe was really nice.
On top of them having so many different cakes, the iced tea and coffee was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I need to thank Futaba for letting me know about this place. I'll send her a message later.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know. Maybe I'll ask everyone if they're keen on having the next after-party here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, wait. Kanade likes the ramen they have at that diner...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Every time I listen to one of your songs whenever I'm not feeling great... Whenever I wonder if I should continue drawing, the thought of creating art for N25 keeps me going.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Plus, I've actually started thinking about what I wanna do after I graduate.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're the reason why I'm even thinking about my own future.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I said something really selfish that time...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But Kanade won't get anything in return at this rate.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm so glad KAITO came to talk...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Bursting in, saying what was on his mind and leaving the way he did was startling. But if he hadn't, Kanade would...

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
Can I get this coffee to go?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, KAITO!
I'm here to talk about Kanade...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, nothing happened...
But I wanted to thank you for what you said.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, because you went out of your way to come talk to her.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So, here's some coffee.
Oh, wait... Do you drink coffee? I forget.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is that your way of making fun of me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? No, that's not what I'm doing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I do want you to listen while you drink that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade... She's helped me so much already.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which is why you coming over to talk to her was really big.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
She helped you...?
Come to think of it, you've mentioned a few things about her songs.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I wanted to go to this one art high school, but I didn't get accepted. I felt so miserable after that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I hit rock bottom...
I wanted to just disappear.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That was when I discovered Kanade's songs...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Oh, is that it...?
I'm in pain...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(This song's so sad...
It's full of pain and suffering, and makes me really want to disappear...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's like it's saying, “No, don't disappear yet.”)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: After joining N25, Kanade said herself that her music needs my art...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: When my art sent me to another dark place, Kanade composed a song and Rin sang for me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She's helped just me this much, so I have to think a lot more people out there have also benefited from her music.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I... I want Kanade to enjoy life more.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know what Kanade's carrying is really heavy and not something she can resolve easily.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But Kanade looked so happy when she saw Mafuyu smile...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I want to see Kanade smile the same way...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If that's how you truly feel, then don't ever let go of it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Even if it's my ego talking...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You could try to be more subtle.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I've finished drinking the coffee.
I'll be going now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh...
Honestly, talk about being the opposite of sociable.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I guess what matters most is that we got to talk.
